name: Two-tone headline and centred word build
purpose: preset pair: two short lines, line 2 in the accent, words rising 0.08 s apart (warns when line 2 is longer). preset build: one centred line that grows word by word on spoken words, the visible words staying centred.

implementation.api: Studio.comp.headline(parent, data, {preset, tone, lineDelay, line2At}) -> {enter(tl, at, {times[], stagger}), word(tl, k, at) (build), warnings, exit}

layout_notes: Display face at 6.4u by default; set the size on the parent's .st-hl for a hook.
